get.summary: Downloads a blob. Authenticated by the bearer token or a presigned download URL.

put.summary:
Uploads bytes under their blake3 digest. Idempotent; rejected if the bytes do not match.
Authenticated by the bearer token or a presigned upload URL.

post.summary: Approves a change's latest revision as the caller, who must be a human.
Comments on a revision of a change, the latest by default, optionally on a line of a file.

Merges a change: its latest revision's checks must have passed, it must fast-forward the
target branch, and changes to protected paths need a human approval. Igloo pushes the
target branch.

Asks for another revision, carrying the comments made since the previous request. A change
made by a task sends them to its agent as its next turn.

Records the source branch's current head as the next revision; an unchanged head records
nothing.

get.summary: Lists the runs of a change, one per revision, oldest first.

Streams a job's output as server-sent events: `stdout` and `stderr` events whose id resumes
the stream through `Last-Event-ID`, then one `end` event with the finished job.
Lists a repository's changes, oldest first.

post.summary: Opens a change proposing a branch pushed to the forge; its head is the first revision.

get.summary: Lists the names of a repository's secrets; values are never returned.

put.summary: Sets or replaces a secret. The body is its value, as text.

post.summary:
Snapshots a repository at a commit: the checkout under `/workspace`, with a shallow `.git`,
over an optional base snapshot. A branch is fetched from the forge first.

get.summary: Lists a repository's tasks, oldest first.

post.summary: Creates a task: the agent starts from the head of the repository's default branch.

get.summary: Lists sandboxes, ordered by id, optionally filtered by labels (`label=key=value`, repeatable).

post.summary: Creates a sandbox from a registered snapshot.
Runs a process in a sandbox as a job.

Seals a running sandbox into a snapshot. The seal completes in the background; poll it with
`GET /v1/seals/{id}`.

put.summary:
Uploads the layer that completes a seal, as a tar archive. Authenticated only by the
presigned URL handed to the sandbox's worker.

parameters.name: layer
parameters.description: `full` for a whole root file system

post.summary: Registers a snapshot of uploaded layers, over a base snapshot's layers if one is named.
Pulls a public container image from its registry and registers its layers as a snapshot.
Cancels a task and stops its sandbox. Cancelling an ended task changes nothing.

get.summary:
A task's transcript from a position on: what its tool said and did, turn by turn, read from
its output with secrets masked. Poll with `after` set to the last response's `next`.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The first position to return; 0 when absent.

ApprovalResource.description: A human's approval of a revision.

revision.description: The revision approved; it must be the latest. The latest when omitted.

merged_commit.description: The target branch's head after the merge, once merged.

exit_code.description: The exit code, when it failed.

job.description: The job running it, whose logs are its output.

line.description: The line of `path` it is about, from 1.

path.description: The file it is about, relative to the repository root.

revision.description: The revision; the latest when omitted.

CommentResource.description: A reviewer's comment on a revision.

author.description: Who wrote it: a user (`usr_...`), an agent (`agt_...`) or `system`.

line.description: The line of `path` it is about, from 1.

CreateSandboxRequest.description: Creates a sandbox from a snapshot.

oneOf.description: Separation from the host; `any` when omitted.
CPU and memory bounds; secure defaults when omitted.

repo.description: The repository the sandbox works on (`repo_...`); its secrets become available to jobs.

CreateSnapshotRequest.description: Registers a snapshot from uploaded blobs, optionally on top of an existing snapshot.

base.description: A snapshot whose layers go underneath, such as an imported image.

CreateTaskRequest.description: Creates a task on a repository.

goal.description: What the agent is asked to do; not empty.

tool.description: A tool of the repository's `.igloo/agents.toml`; its default tool when absent.

ExecRequest.description: Runs a process in a sandbox.

env.description: Extra environment, layered over the sandbox's.

secrets.description: Secrets of the sandbox's repository to expose as environment variables, by name.

timeout_seconds.description: How long the process may run, 1 to 86400 seconds; one hour when omitted.

FieldError.description: One invalid field of a request.

ImportImageRequest.description: Imports a public OCI image as a snapshot.

image.description: An image reference, such as `docker.io/library/rust:1.99` or `rust:1.99`.

platform.description: `os/architecture`, such as `linux/arm64`; the server's architecture when omitted.

Isolation.description: How strongly a sandbox is separated from its host.

JobPhase.description: Where a job is in its lifecycle.

secrets.description: The repository secrets it is given, by name.

timeout_seconds.description: How long the process may run.

media_type.description: How the blob is encoded; `tar` when omitted.

millicpus.description: CPU in thousandths of a core, 100 to 64000.

MediaType.description: How a layer blob is encoded.

OpenChangeRequest.description: Opens a change for a branch pushed to the forge.

title.description: What the change does, 1 to 200 characters.

Problem.description:
An error response. `code` is stable and machine-readable; `title` and `detail` are for
humans.

code.description: The stable error code, such as `"sandbox.not_found"`.

detail.description: What went wrong in this occurrence.

errors.description: Every invalid field, for validation problems.

title.description: A short summary of the problem type.

type.description: A URI identifying the problem type.

default_branch.description: The branch changes merge into; `main` when omitted.

location.description: `github.com/<owner>/<name>`, or an absolute path on the server for development.

token_secret.description: The repository secret holding the forge token, such as `GITHUB_TOKEN`.
The secret holding the forge token.

RepoSnapshotRequest.description:
Makes a snapshot of a repository at a commit: its checkout under `/workspace`, with a shallow
`.git`, over `base`. Names exactly one of `branch` (fetched first) and `commit`.

base.description: The snapshot to check out over, such as an imported image.

commit.description: A commit of the default branch's history.

base.description: Where it forked from the target branch.

RunResource.description: A run of a change's revision.

checks.description: Its checks, in pipeline order; empty until prepared.

warm_job.description: The job of the warm build this run did, if any; its logs are the build's output.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; absent on the last page.

SandboxPhase.description: Where a sandbox is in its lifecycle.

SandboxResource.description: A sandbox: its desired spec and observed status.

generation.description: The spec generation; bumped by every spec change.

observed_generation.description: The generation the worker last reported acting on.

worker.description: The worker it is assigned to.

SealResource.description: A seal of a sandbox into a snapshot.

SecretList.description: The names of a repository's secrets. Values are never returned.

id.description: Its id: the digest of its manifest.

change.description: The change its commits form, once it has one.

commit.description: The commit it started from, once settled.

goal.description: What the agent is asked to do.

TranscriptEntry.description: An entry of a task's transcript.

position.description: Its position in the transcript, from 0.

turn.description: The turn it belongs to, from 1.

oneOf.description: Text the tool wrote to the reader.
The tool called one of its tools.

id.description: The call's id, matching its result.

oneOf.description: A line of output the tool's harness does not read further.

TranscriptItem.description: One thing a tool did or said.

TranscriptResource.description: A task's transcript from a position on.

idle.description: Whether no turn runs, so no entries follow until another turn starts.

next.description: The position to read from next.

job.description: The job running the tool, whose logs are its output.
